observations: A lean, open-mouthed figure occupies the center against a flat olive-green ground; wide dark-shadowed eye sockets and bared teeth face the viewer directly.
Layered lines in yellow, pink, teal, and white trace the torso and limbs, leaving forms semi-transparent so the olive ground reads through the body.
Both arms extend outward and one leg kicks forward, with splayed digit clusters at each extremity; large cast shadows anchor the figure to the lower left and right.
reading: The figure lunges forward, arms wide and mouth open, yet the layered lines keep it weightless rather than solid. Yellow and pink loops suggest muscle or tendon without resolving into anatomy. The olive ground holds steady while the body flickers between outline and form. That tension—between urgency and transparency—gives the image its unsettled charge.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, title neighbors are nnxyz nnotb #31 and nnxyz nnotb #33. #31 uses a warm amber ground with a striding figure; #33 shifts to black with a compact crouching form. #32 sits between those two in palette weight and spatial openness.

connections.reason: Both show a full-body figure in mid-motion with limbs extended, but #31 uses a saturated amber ground with denser color fills, while #32 keeps the body more open and line-dominant against olive.
Both figures show bared teeth and dark hollow eye treatment, but #33 compresses the body into a squat shape on black, whereas #32 stretches limbs wide on a mid-tone ground.

lookingQuestion: Where do the layered lines overlap enough to read as solid form, and where do they stay open so the ground shows through—does that shift happen evenly across the body or concentrate in one area?
ambiguities: The collector's stated connection between scrimshaw and nnxyz works rests on visual pattern qualities; no artist statement confirms this reading.
nnxyz nifty faces #119 was inspected but shares only a dark ground and tooth-like marks with #32; the formal overlap is too limited to support a useful connection over the direct title neighbors.
